metadata.description: Real-time road traffic incidents in Japan. Aggregated from Yahoo!道路交通情報, Yahoo!トランジット, NHK RSS (cat7), and MLIT. traffic_multiplier reflects incident impact on local risk model.
metadata.notes: JARTIC (jartic.or.jp) was replaced with Yahoo!道路交通情報 (road.yahoo.co.jp) due to 404 errors on the JARTIC public page. NHK RSS cat7 covers society/traffic news (事故/渋滞/通行止め). Lat/lon is available only when the source provides coordinates directly.
